data.name: Racetrack Tycoon
data.detailed_description:
BUILD YOUR RACING CALENDAR

Attract over 40 unique racing series ranging from grassroots club racing to prestigious world championship events.

Each series brings its own expectations, regulations, fanbase, and venue requirements. Expand your facilities, upgrade your circuit, and carefully plan your calendar to transform a modest racing venue into a world-class motorsport destination.

A TRUE TYCOON CHALLENGE

Success requires more than building a great race track.

Balance your budget, satisfy strict safety requirements, optimize spectator viewing and comfort, manage food, drink and merchandise operations, and meet the increasingly demanding expectations of racing series and fans.

Every investment matters.

REAL WORLD SCALE

Racetrack Tycoon simulates motorsport venues at true 1:1 scale. Design flowing circuits, sprawling spectator areas, high-end facilities, and expansive infrastructue without the compression and shortcuts common in other management games.

From small club circuits to the biggest stages in motorsport, every metre of your venue matters as you optimize for your paying customers, the fans.

THOUSANDS OF FANS. ONE LIVING VENUE.

Watch your venue come alive as tens of thousands of spectators attend your events. Guests arrive, explore the circuit, visit facilities, purchase food and merchandise, and search for the best places to watch the action. The focus with Racetrack Tycoon is on our expansive and sophisticated simulation which takes place on an impressively realistic scale.

Racetrack Tycoon challenges you to manage your budget, meet demanding series requirements, and entertain tens of thousands of fans.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum specifications may change during development
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
